source: Hand-curated for Forevercraft (not generated). Every effect, its scope (raid / group / single target) and which specs can provide it was read from this site's own data/spellbooks.json and data/talents/*.json, both synced to the WoW Forever beta client. wowtbc.gg's raid comp planner was looked at only to see which effects players track; none of its data was copied. Validated by scripts/check-raid-buffs.js (runs in prebuild).

conventions.specs: "all" = a spell every member of the class learns. A list of talent-tree names = a talent (or a spellbook spell flagged talent: true), credited only to that tree's spec.
conventions.confidence: On an effect: its scope and numbers, read from spell text. On a source: whether that spec really provides it. On an onlyOneCounts / perCaster set: the stacking or one-at-a-time rule, which spell text usually doesn't state.
conventions.evidence: Optional, never rendered: web sources found for a stacking rule (url, which game era the source describes, what it says). A set is only confirmed by an official Blizzard source or a specific in-game test, never by Classic-era sources or forum consensus. Last research pass 2026-10-19.

onlyOneCounts.label: Major armor reduction
onlyOneCounts.note: Blizzard: Sunder Armor won't overwrite Expose Armor unless its effect is weaker. Warriors can still use Sunder for threat while Expose is up.

evidence.says: Expose Armor reduction raised to match 5 Sunder Armor applications; Expose no longer prevents Sunder from being used; Sunder still won't overwrite Expose unless its effect is weaker.

onlyOneCounts.label: -505 armor
onlyOneCounts.note: All three reduce armor by exactly 505. Beta testers report they don't stack with each other in Forever (they did in Classic), but Blizzard hasn't said so.

evidence.says: Fixed multiple Faerie Fire debuffs being active on a target; same fix for Curse of Recklessness. That is each spell with itself, not Faerie Fire with Curse of Recklessness.

evidence.era: Forever beta (community wiki, unmarked = tooltip/client data/testing, not Blizzard-confirmed)
evidence.says: Dust Cloud does not stack with Faerie Fire or with Curse of Recklessness.

evidence.era: Forever beta (third-party project PR, Oct 4; repo not publicly readable as of 2026-10-19, seen only via search snippet)
evidence.says: Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness share their armor reduction, citing Wowhead's Forever Fury Warrior guide; notes the client data has no shared category.

onlyOneCounts.label: -204 attack power
onlyOneCounts.note: All four lower attack power by exactly 204. Demoralizing Shout and Roar didn't stack in Classic.

evidence.says: Demoralizing Roar tuned to be identical to Demoralizing Shout at level 60. Says nothing about stacking. No Forever source found on stacking for any of the four.

onlyOneCounts.label: -2% hit
onlyOneCounts.note: Insect Swarm and Scorpid Sting didn't stack in Classic.

evidence.says: Multiple instances of Insect Swarm no longer keep reducing the target's hit chance. Insect Swarm with itself only; nothing found on Insect Swarm with Scorpid Sting.

onlyOneCounts.label: +25% armor on heal crit
onlyOneCounts.note: Ancestral Healing and Inspiration give the same buff value and didn't stack in Classic.

onlyOneCounts.label: Weapon-proc totems
onlyOneCounts.note: Blizzard: Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem don't stack, even from different Shamans. Grace of Air stacks with both.

evidence.says: Sept 24: Flametongue Totem no longer stacks with Windfury Totem. Oct 16: Grace of Air Totem is no longer exclusive with Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem; Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem retain their exclusivity.

perCaster.label: Blessings
perCaster.note: Spell text: players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin. Salvation is not a Blessing in Forever, so it isn't in this set.

perCaster.label: Auras
perCaster.note: Spell text: only one Aura per Paladin.

perCaster.label: Judgements
perCaster.note: Spell text: only one Judgement per Paladin can be active.

perCaster.label: Curses
perCaster.note: Spell text: only one Curse per Warlock on any one target.

perCaster.label: Air totems
perCaster.note: One totem per element in Classic. Forever's spell text and Blizzard's notes don't restate it; a Forever shaman guide does.

evidence.era: Forever (third-party guide, no source cited for this rule)
evidence.says: You can only have one totem of a specific element active at a time.
Nothing on one-per-element. Sept 24 made Tranquil Air, Windfury and Grace of Air exclusive across Shamans; Oct 16 freed Grace of Air from Windfury and Flametongue (see windfury-flametongue).

perCaster.label: Water totems
perCaster.note: One totem per element in Classic. Forever's spell text doesn't restate it.

evidence.era: Forever (third-party guide, no source cited for this rule)
evidence.says: One totem of each element at a time; lists Healing Stream, Mana Spring and Mana Tide as Water totems. Nothing official found.

perCaster.label: Pet abilities
perCaster.note: Each comes from a different pet family (wolf, tallstrider, carrion bird), and a Hunter has one pet out at a time.

evidence.says: Each pet family now has one ability unique to it: Wolf Furious Howl, Tallstrider Dust Cloud, Carrion Bird Demoralizing Screech. Confirms the family requirement; one pet at a time is not restated for Forever, so the set stays estimated.
